questions.question: Mr Botha has 24 m of fencing. Compare a 2 m by 10 m run with a 6 m by 6 m run.
questions.expected_answer: Both have a perimeter of 24 m. The 2 m by 10 m run has an area of 20 square metres, but the 6 m by 6 m run has an area of 36 square metres, so the square gives the chickens more space.

questions.question: Find the surface area and the volume of a box 4 cm by 3 cm by 2 cm.
questions.expected_answer: The faces are two of 12, two of 8 and two of 6 square centimetres, so the surface area is 24 + 16 + 12 = 52 square centimetres. The volume is 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 cubic centimetres.

questions.question: Of all rectangles with an area of 36 square metres, which has the smallest perimeter?
questions.expected_answer: The 6 m by 6 m square, with a perimeter of 24 m. Long, thin rectangles have bigger perimeters; for example, 1 m by 36 m needs 74 m.
